explosionwand.jei.rift_core: Dropped in the loot chest of the Rift Heart. Use the Rift Key and defeat the Heart in its dimension to reach it.
explosionwand.jei.eclipse_heart: Dropped in the loot chest of the Eclipse King. The boss is summoned with the Eclipse Seal, which requires a Rift Core.
explosionwand.jei.dream_staff: Found in the loot chest of the Dream Monolith together with the Dreaming Eye. The Monolith is summoned with the Dreamer's Seal, crafted from an Eclipse Heart.
explosionwand.jei.dreaming_eye: Dropped in the loot chest of the Dream Monolith. Needed for the Sky Seal, which summons the Sky Whale.
explosionwand.jei.whale_staff: Found in the loot chest of the Sky Whale. Summon it with the Sky Seal, which requires a Dreaming Eye.
item.explosionwand.seal_shard_rift.desc: Held in hand, pulls toward the nearest Rift. Trembles and rings nearby. Unlocks its door.
explosionwand.shard.near: The shard trembles and rings: %s is very close
explosionwand.shard.silent: The shard is silent: no trace of the Seal here
explosionwand.dungeon.locked.rift: The crystal door is locked. Unlock it with the Seal Shard: Rift
explosionwand.dungeon.brazier_lit: Brazier lit: you will respawn here
explosionwand.dungeon.cleared: Hall complete: a reward chest appeared
explosionwand.dungeon.peaceful: The dungeon sleeps in peaceful mode
explosionwand.dungeon.no_teleport: The dungeon walls refuse you: teleportation does not work
explosionwand.dungeon.no_wand: This wand is silent inside a dungeon
explosionwand.dungeon.solved: The mechanism clicks: a passage has opened somewhere
explosionwand.dungeon.lever: The lever is pulled: something shifts in the wall
explosionwand.dungeon.seal_shut: The door slams shut. There is no way back until the lair falls silent
